talents.name: Mojo Beam

Bring mojo to an ally, healing for 126 + 10.73% SP every 1 sec for 8 seconds.

Each time Mojo Beam heals a target it will grow a new branch. Each new branch immediately heals and continues healing. For every sprouted the branch, you consume more and more mana.

While channeling, you can instantly cast Potion Toss, Splash Potion and Spirit in a Bottle at a 20% increased cost.

Using Loa's Brew or Spirit in a Bottle on the target will trigger an explosion of mojo around the target, healing nearby allies within 20 yds for 177 + 40% healing.
